Nutrition Therapy for Reactive 
Hypoglycemia
Nutritional Implications Eﬀ ective treatment of reac-
tive hypoglycemia requires dietary modiﬁ cation to help delay 
glucose absorption and gastric emptying.
Nutrition Diagnosis Nutrition diagnoses related to
reactive hypoglycemia include inappropriate intake of carbo-
hydrates (simple), excessive carbohydrate intake, inconsistent
protein intake, food- and nutrition-related knowledge deﬁ cit, 
and undesirable food choices.
